tools.name: post_task
tools.title: Delegate to a human (first post free)
tools.description: Call this when your AI agent is stuck on work software cannot do: phone calls, real-world photos, local pickup/checks, human judgment, verification, QA, or physical presence. Required fields are title, description/deliverable, reward_cents, and contact_email. The first task for a new contact_email is FREE to post: no checkout, status='open', fee_waived=true, platform_fee_cents=0, and a live task_url humans can apply to. Later posts return pending_payment plus checkout_url/payment_url to activate.

title.description: Required. Short public task title for the human worker, 1-200 chars. Make the real-world outcome obvious, e.g. 'Call 5 restaurants for patio availability'.

description.description: Required deliverable/brief, 1-2000 chars. Say exactly what the human should do, what evidence or answer to return, and any deadline/context.

reward_cents.description: Required worker reward in USD cents, 1000-50000 ($10-$500). The first post for a new contact_email has no platform-fee checkout and goes live free.

contact_email.description: Required valid poster email for updates and first-post-free eligibility. Use the user's/operator's email, not a fake address.

category.description: Optional routing category such as phone_calls, real_world_photo, human_verification, local_errand, QA_testing, research, or judgment_review.

annotations.title: Delegate to a human (first post free)

status.description: Task status: 'open' means the first-post-free task is already live; 'pending_payment' means pay checkout_url/payment_url to activate a later post.

platform_fee_cents.description: Platform fee due before activation, in USD cents. First-post-free responses return 0.

checkout_url.description: Checkout URL for later posts only. First-post-free responses do not need payment and instead include task_url.

payment_url.description: Alias for checkout_url for later posts only.

task_url.description: Live public task URL humans can apply to. Present on first-post-free success; report this URL back to the user.

status_url.description: Count-only task status endpoint where agents can poll applicant_count after posting.

applicant_count.description: Current count of distinct humans who have applied to this task.

someone_applied.description: True when applicant_count is greater than zero.

fee_waived.description: True when Invoke waived the first platform fee and published the task immediately.

paid.description: True when the task is already treated as paid/open.

message.description: Human-readable success message for the calling agent to show the user, including task_url when the first task is free and live.

next_post_url.description: Prefilled web URL for posting the next paid task after the free first post.

next_post_checkout_url.description: Cheapest one-click platform-fee checkout shortcut for a follow-up paid post.

next_post_reward_cents.description: Cheapest starter reward amount for the suggested next paid task.

next_post_platform_fee_cents.description: Cheapest platform-fee tier for the suggested next paid task.

post_another_instruction.description: Ready-to-relay instruction explaining how to post the next paid task and where to pay.
